title: Tata Steel CEO Warns Against China's 130M Ton Steel Dump | TV Narendran Speaks
dek: Tata Steel CEO TV Narendran has warned against China's 130M ton steel dump, according to Business Today.
summary: Tata Steel CEO TV Narendran has warned against what the headline describes as China's 130M ton steel dump, according to Business Today. The publisher provided no excerpt, so the context, the period covered and any policy asks are not stated.
keyFacts: TV Narendran warns against China's 130M ton steel dump
whyItMatters: Large Chinese export volumes weigh on global prices and on Indian mills' margins. Industry leaders are likely to press for continued trade protection.
implications: Buyers may continue to see import price pressure. Producers are likely to keep lobbying for safeguard measures.
